abilities.name: Candle Confession
abilities.description: Light a candle beside someone sleeping and hear one sentence they would never say awake.
abilities.cost: The candle must burn down fully; you dream of what you heard

growth.grows: how many sentences and how deep the secret

abilities.name: Grave Chill Sense
abilities.description: Touch the ground and sense whether anyone is buried beneath it, and roughly how long ago.
abilities.cost: Cold fingers that will not warm for an hour

growth.grows: how deep and how far back it reaches

abilities.name: Threshold Manners
abilities.description: When you invite or refuse someone at a door, they cannot cross it for one hour unless they force it in plain sight.
abilities.cost: Only works on doors of a home you have slept in

growth.grows: how strong a visitor it holds and how long

abilities.name: Portrait Watch
abilities.description: Look into a painted portrait and see the room it hangs in as it was an hour ago.
abilities.cost: The painted eyes follow you for the rest of the night

growth.grows: how far back and how many portraits you can use

abilities.name: Bloodless Wound
abilities.description: Hold a cut closed for a minute and it stops bleeding without leaving a mark.
abilities.cost: You feel the wound's pain yourself for a day

growth.grows: how deep a cut it closes

abilities.name: Mourner's Composure
abilities.description: You can keep perfectly calm in the presence of horror, so fear cannot make you drop or flee for one scene.
abilities.cost: The fear arrives all at once when the scene ends

growth.grows: how terrible a sight you can stand

abilities.name: Crypt Key Sense
abilities.description: Hold a key and know which lock in the house it belongs to, if that lock is within a hundred paces.
abilities.cost: One key at a time; old locks resist

growth.grows: how far the lock can be

abilities.name: Dusk Walker
abilities.description: Move through shadows at dusk so the eye slides past you until the last light is gone.
abilities.cost: Useless in full dark or daylight; leaves you shivering

growth.grows: how long after dusk it lasts and how close you can pass

abilities.name: Silver Test
abilities.description: Touch a silver coin to someone's skin under a pretext and see whether they flinch from it.
abilities.cost: Needs a real silver coin and a believable reason

growth.grows: how subtle the flinch you can catch

abilities.name: Bell of the Dead
abilities.description: Ring a small bell to call any restless spirit in the room; it must show itself as a shape for a moment.

growth.grows: how strong a spirit must answer and how long it stays

abilities.name: Old Blood Courtesy
abilities.description: Speak the courtly forms of the blood nobility so a vampire treats you as a guest, not prey, until you give offense.
abilities.cost: Any rudeness ends the protection and is remembered

growth.grows: how old a creature respects it

abilities.name: Wolfsbane Nose
abilities.description: Smell a person and sense whether they have changed shape in the last week.
abilities.cost: Sneezing fits after; the scent lingers on you

growth.grows: how long ago and how faint a trace
